purpose: predicateType 文字列 `https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1` (URL bar ではなく文字列を使う)、parsing rules (unrecognized fields MUST ignore、major version のみ URI 变更、minor は backwards compatible・monotonic、unset/null/empty 等価)、schema (buildDefinition: buildType/externalParameters/internalParameters/resolvedDependencies、runDetails: builder/metadata/byproducts)、externalParameters は untrusted で MUST included・MUST verified downstream・Build L3 で MUST complete・verifiers SHOULD reject unrecognized/unexpected fields、Build L1 REQUIRED (buildDefinition/runDetails/buildType/externalParameters/builder)、consumers MUST accept only specific signer–builder pairs、builder.id が SLSA Build level の sole determiner、ResourceDescriptor digest keys (sha256/sha512/gitCommit)、v1.2 変更履歴は provenance build-model 図の明確化のみ (schema は v1.0 から不変) を確認する
